Definition: from G3870; imploration, hortation, solace:--comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty.
BiblicalUsage: Paraklēsis is comfort, consolation, exhortation. God comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble; the Scriptures were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope; and the churches walk in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost and are multiplied.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe comfort is passed hand to hand. God comforts me, the Scriptures comfort me, and then I am sent to comfort others with the comfort I received.
